remarks:
Unique Stone Home with Character, Space & Endless Entertaining Possibilities!

Step into a home where timeless charm meets room to spread out and enjoy! This distinctive 5-bedroom, 2-full-bath stone home offers character, warmth, and an abundance of space both inside and out. The remodeled kitchen provides a fresh, inviting feel, with a full bath conveniently located just off the kitchen. A formal dining room, office, living room, and charming parlor offer plenty of options for everyday living, entertaining, or working from home. A wonderful family room addition takes entertaining to the next level, featuring a gas fireplace, bar, and plenty of room for a pool table and large or small gatherings .

Upstairs, you'll find spacious bedrooms and a full bath featuring a classic clawfoot tub with shower. Double staircases add to the home's unique character and appeal. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening on the inviting covered front porch, or head to the back deck overlooking the beautiful, park-like yard.

The outdoor amenities offer something for everyone, including an above-ground pool, a pavilion perfect for covered picnics and gatherings, and an outbuilding with a greenhouse for gardening enthusiasts. The detached garage offers ample space for two vehicles or a fifth-wheel camper. An additional one-car garage sits alongside a metal building with attic storage and space suitable for chickens or other small animals, making this property an appealing option for those dreaming of a homestead lifestyle.

If you're looking for a home with distinctive character, generous living space, and room to entertain, garden, and enjoy the outdoors, this one-of-a-kind property is ready to capture your imagination!
